fullPassage: There has been a lot of discussion on why moths are attracted to light. The consensus seems to hold that moths are not so much attracted to lights as they are trapped by them. The light becomes a sensory overload that disorients the insects and sends them into a holding pattern. A hypothesis called the Mach band theory suggests that moths see a dark area around a light source and head for it to escape the light. Another theory suggests that moths perceive the light coming from a source as a diffuse halo with a dark spot in the center. The moths, attempting to escape the light, fly toward that imagined “portal,” bringing them closer to the source. As they approach the light, their reference point changes and they circle the light hopelessly trying to reach the portal. Everyone is familiar with moths circling their porch lights. Their flight appears to have no purpose, but they are, it is believed, trying to escape the pull of the light.

A hypothesis called the Mach band theory suggests that moths see a dark area around a light source and head for it to escape the light. ③<u>Another theory</u> suggests that moths perceive the light coming from a source as a diffuse halo with a dark spot in the center. ④<u>The moths</u>, attempting to escape the light, fly toward that imagined “portal,” bringing them closer to the source. As they approach the light, their reference point changes and they circle the light hopelessly trying to reach the portal. Everyone is familiar with moths circling their porch lights. Their flight appears to have no purpose, but they are, it is believed, trying to escape the pull of the light.
questions.stem: ①~④ 중 윗글의 내용과 다른 문장은?

det.korean: ③: 본문에서 나방은 빛을 'a diffuse halo with a dark spot in the center'로 인식한다고 했는데, ③에서 'a focused beam with a bright spot'으로 바뀌었습니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 나방이 빛에 끌리는 이유에 대한 논의와 갇힘 설명: 원문과 일치.
✅ ② 감각 과부하와 마흐 밴드 이론: 원문과 일치.
❌ ③ 'focused beam with a bright spot' → 원문은 'diffuse halo with a dark spot'. 초점광선과 밝은 점이 아니라 분산된 후광과 어두운 점. ← 정답
✅ ④ 상상의 출구와 기준점 변화: 원문과 일치.
det.tip: diffuse halo(분산된 후광) ≠ focused beam(초점 광선), dark spot ≠ bright spot

다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Moths appear to be (A)_______ by light, but they are actually (B)_______ by it.

det.korean: (A) attracted, (B) trapped: 나방은 빛에 '끌리는' 것처럼 보이지만 실제로는 '갇히는' 것입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① attracted — trapped: 본문 핵심 내용. not so much attracted as trapped. ← 정답
❌ ② repelled — guided: 나방이 빛에 '밀려나서' '안내된다'는 본문과 반대.
❌ ③ attracted — released: '끌려서 풀려난다'는 갇힘과 반대.
❌ ④ frightened — protected: '겁먹어서 보호된다'는 본문과 무관.
det.tip: not so much attracted as trapped = 끌리기보다는 갇힌 것
